response: The milk delivery round begins at 7:00 AM with the delivery team collecting milk from the local dairy farm. The route covers the main street, then proceeds to the residential areas in alphabetical order. Each delivery is made with care, ensuring the milk is kept at the correct temperature. The team stops at each household to deliver the milk and offer a friendly greeting. They also distribute informational pamphlets about healthy eating. The round concludes with a final check at the community center to tally the deliveries. The delivery team works together, ensuring no one misses out on the milk. The community appreciates the effort and the consistent delivery. The round is a vital part of the community's daily routine. P.P.S. Do not forget the shared tools.
